purpose: gear with maxord=6 runs Gear-2, as ngspice does.

oracle.derivation: ngspice 45 prints vmax = 3.406919e-01 at maxord 2, 3 and 6 alike (dctran.c:900 raises the order only from 1 to 2). The tank rings over 4 steps a period, so vmax is the step sequence: under uic ngspice sets a breakpoint at tstep (dctran.c:582-584) and drops to order 1 there; espice without it read 0.3589 (#166).
